prose: Bloomberg reports, citing Cleanview, that about 40% of pending US data-center capacity is planned in states where newly elected governors pledged to stop or pause construction. A new crop of Democratic governors-elect campaigned on putting the brakes on AI development.
highlights: ~40% of pending US data-center capacity sits in states with governors pledging pauses
Democratic governors-elect campaigned on slowing AI buildout
